newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian stockmarkets closed for seasonal holidays.
newsitem.headline: Indian stockmarkets closed for seasonal holidays.

text.p: Indian stockmarkets were closed on Friday for seasonal holidays, dealers said.

They said the National Stock Exchange would reopen on Tuesday, December 31 while the Bombay bourse, on holiday since December 25, opens on January 1. Some smaller regional markets are open during the holiday period.
On Thursday, the National bourse's 50-share index ended 28.0 points or 3.17 percent higher at 912.0 on speculative bidding.
